Scissor Lift Safety System

The Anshengda safety system combines ultrasonic obstacle sensing, staged warnings and automatic stopping for compatible scissor lifts.

Discuss your project↘

How it works

Overhead clearance

Guardrail-mounted ultrasonic sensors check clearance above and diagonally above the platform as it rises.

Travel sensing and stop signal

Front and rear sensors detect obstacles during travel. The controller issues audible and visual warnings as clearance closes and can command a stop at the critical zone on a compatible machine.

Contact edge and diagnostics

Flexible pressure-sensitive edges can trigger an emergency stop on contact. The controller display identifies the trigger and, for a distance alert, displays the detected distance.

Configuration and specifications

Detection
Ultrasonic sensing in front, behind and above; pressure-sensitive contact edges
Controller
IP65 controller enclosure per the supplier deck
Machine interface
Connects at the original joystick interface on compatible machines
